subject: Business Models
title: Autonomous Customer Service
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Autonomous Customer Service.

hook.text: Klarna replaced 700 customer service agents with AI in 2024. The AI handles 66% of all inquiries alone.

buildup.text: AI chatbots now resolve complaints, process returns, and answer complex questions without human escalation.

discovery.text: Klarna's AI does the work of 700 agents. Resolution time dropped from 11 minutes to 2 minutes per inquiry.

twist.text: Customers sometimes prefer AI: no hold times, no judgment, available 24/7. Speed beats empathy for routine issues.

climax.text: AI customer service will eliminate millions of jobs globally. The model saves money but creates social disruption.

punchline.text: 700 agents replaced, 2-minute resolutions. AI support is faster but jobs vanish.

quiz.question: How much did Klarna's AI reduce resolution time?
